questions.topic: PrepLadder · 66.Autoimmune and Inflammatory Diseases in Medicine
questions.stemHtml: A 30 y/o woman presents with a persistent cough, fatigue, and painful red nodules on her lower legs. Her ACE levels were found to be elevated and her chest x-ray findings are given below. She has a family history of autoimmune diseases and carries the HLA-DRB1*03 haplotype. What pathophysiological feature is most likely contributing to her condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Accumulation of neutrophils and eosinophils in lung tissue.

options.label: B
options.text: Interaction between antigen-presenting cells and T-helper cells leading to granuloma formation.

options.label: C
options.text: Decreased production of cytokines such as IL-2 and IFN-γ.

options.label: D
options.text: High levels of cyclosporine in the serum affecting T-cell activity.
